title: Messaging Check Access List Membership — payload

did.description: The target account's DID whose access list is being checked.

entries.description: The DIDs to test for membership in the account's access list.

Response.title: Messaging Check Access List Membership — response payload
Response.description: The success response to a messaging/access-list/get request. Carried in a Trust Task document whose type is https://trusttasks.org/spec/messaging/access-list/get/0.1#response.

did.description: The account whose access list was checked.

present.description: The supplied entries that are present in the account's access list.

absent.description: The supplied entries that are not present in the account's access list.
